en.title: Tech Lead
en.stack: React, Next.js, Node.js, NestJS, TypeScript, Python, PHP, Laravel, GraphQL, PostgreSQL, MySQL, Redis, AWS, Docker, Kubernetes

details.heading: Tech Lead (2023–2024)
items: Led the migration of a legacy PHP monolith to microservices in Node.js, Python (FastAPI) and .NET Core, with a GraphQL gateway for unified API access, Docker and Kubernetes.
Led the development of five major projects, with Node.js/NestJS and PHP/Laravel backends exposing REST and GraphQL APIs, and React/Next.js and Blade frontends.
Built GraphQL APIs with NestJS and PostgreSQL, with automated tests, caching and deployment on AWS (EC2, S3, Lambda) through Jenkins pipelines.
Built serverless data processing with S3, SQS and Lambda, reducing latency by 40% in real-time APIs.
Led the analysis of new projects with the Product team, turning portfolio management and risk requirements into technically feasible plans.

details.heading: Backend Developer (2022–2023)
items: Built web applications and APIs with Node.js, TypeScript, Next.js and Python, connecting frontend and backend through GraphQL and REST.
Designed GraphQL APIs with Apollo Server — queries, mutations and subscriptions — and unified services with schema stitching and federation.
Built a real-time monitoring dashboard with GraphQL subscriptions, Redis caching, PostgreSQL query tuning and CloudWatch alerts.
Built serverless architectures on AWS with Lambda, SQS, CloudWatch and S3.
Took part in the whole development cycle, from planning to delivery and maintenance, with GitLab and Jira.

details.heading: Frontend Developer (2021–2022)
items: Built responsive interfaces with React, TypeScript, Material UI and Bootstrap, with state managed in Redux.
Consumed GraphQL APIs with Apollo Client, using queries, fragments and caching to cut over-fetching.
Built Reparofone, a device repair management system, end to end: React and Redux on the frontend, GraphQL and REST APIs in PHP (Laravel) with MySQL.
Improved Reparofone's API performance by 30% with resolver optimization and query batching.
Investigated and fixed frontend performance problems, and took part in code reviews and unit testing.
